mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO feed_like (feed_id, user_id, create_time , tenant_id) VALUES (#{feedId}, #{userId}, NOW() , #{tenantId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM feed_like WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM feed_like WHERE feed_id = #{feedId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
